mapper.select: SELECT st.id AS stock_id, st.product_id, p.product_name, st.quantity FROM stocks st JOIN products p ON p.id = st.product_id WHERE st.store_id = #{storeId} AND st.product_id IN #{productId} ORDER BY st.product_id FOR UPDATE OF st
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_histories (store_id, product_id, type, quantity, before_quantity, after_quantity, reference_type, reference_id, reason, created_by) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{productId}, #{type}, #{quantity}, #{beforeQuantity}, #{afterQuantity}, #{referenceType}, #{referenceId}, #{reason}, #{createdBy})
mapper.sql: st.store_id, s.store_name, st.product_id, p.product_code, p.product_name, c.category_name, p.status AS product_status, st.quantity, st.safety_stock, (p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND st.quantity < st.safety_stock) AS shortage
FROM stocks st JOIN stores s ON s.id = st.store_id JOIN products p ON p.id = st.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id

FROM stock_histories h JOIN stores s ON s.id = h.store_id JOIN products p ON p.id = h.product_id JOIN users u ON u.id = h.created_by LEFT JOIN sales sa ON h.reference_type = 'SALE' AND sa.id = h.reference_id LEFT JOIN purchase_orders po ON h.reference_type = 'PURCHASE_ORDER' AND po.id = h.reference_id
mapper.select:
SELECT h.id, h.created_at, h.store_id, s.store_name, h.product_id, p.product_code, p.product_name, h.type, h.quantity, h.before_quantity, h.after_quantity, h.reference_type, h.reference_id, COALESCE(sa.sale_number, po.order_number) AS reference_number, h.reason, u.name AS created_by_name
ORDER BY h.created_at DESC, h.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
